_help: Loaded at import; restart the job after editing. Module titles come from folder names, not a fixed list.
Regex flags are inline. Keep capture group 1 for week_dir, frontmatter, todo, wikilink, concept_heading and week_reference.
week_reference and score_word use format placeholders {title} and {word}; runtime values are regex-escaped. Double any other braces in these two patterns.
Naming and text templates use Python format placeholders. Keep week_note, week_reference, prep_stem and displayed week labels consistent.
The default vault is shared with vault_search; --vault overrides it. Paths below are relative to that vault.

header: description: "Prep for {title} Week {week}: topics from the week's file names and notes, what is still open from Week {prior_week}, and earlier ideas to have ready. Built by Denisse from titles only."
> Every line below is a file name, a note title, a heading or a line already in your notes. Nothing here says what the lecture contains — that is for you to write up in {week_link}.
templates.no_topics: - None: the week folder has no lecture or tutorial file with a topic in its name.
templates.no_todos: - Nothing marked `[!todo]` in the Week {prior_week} note.
templates.no_earlier: - No earlier concept section shares a word with this week's topics.
